response.sql: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(GOT - GPT) AS avg_ast_minus_alt, AVG(APTT - PT) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC > 6.5 GROUP BY CENTROMEA) SELECT AVG(avg_ast_minus_alt) AS avg_ast_minus_alt, AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM status_averages;
